title: The concert that oversold
description: Box Office counts the tickets it has left. Keep the concert from selling more than it has when Box Office scales out.
instructions: Box Office sells the concert's 500 tickets. Five seconds in, it scales out to three instances to keep up with the buyers.
Sell every ticket exactly once, however many instances are running. Tickets is a table every instance can reach.

events.text: Box Office scales out to three instances

goals.title: Every buyer reaches Box Office through Ticket Balancer
goals.hint: A request generator sends to one instance, so a buyer wired straight to Box Office only ever reaches the first one.

goals.title: Nobody is turned away while tickets are left
goals.hint: At 40 buyers a second the last ticket cannot go in the first 10 seconds, so a sold out that early means a buyer was refused a ticket that existed.

goals.title: Exactly 500 tickets are sold
goals.hint: Each instance is a separate process, so each one has its own count of what is left. An instance that starts late starts the same way the first one did.

goals.title: Every buyer is answered, with a ticket or a sold out
goals.hint: Sold out is an answer, and the starting code sends it as a 409. An error is not.
